verdict: BatteryLife CPMLP/CPTransformer and PBT are early total cycle-life/EOL prediction, not dynamic RUL.

findings.claim: BatteryLife task uses first S cycles, S<=100, to predict scalar cycle life. Paper defines EOL at the cycle where SOH<=80%, except CALB uses 90% and Q1 reference.
Paper excludes final SOH above lambda+2.5%; linearly extrapolates labels for final SOH in (lambda,lambda+2.5%]; lambda=80% except CALB 90%, using Q1 as Q0 for CALB.

CPMLP/CPTransformer are CyclePatch BLP models, not dynamic RUL. Scripts use early_cycle_threshold=100, MSE, scalar c_out=1, two processes; defaults are CALB and MIX_large respectively. Model heads return scalars.
Loader reads per-cell EOL from Life labels JSON and appends labels.append(eol) for each prefix. It never subtracts observed cycle i; dynamic RUL needs a separate EOL-i target.
Each battery generates overlapping prefix samples with the same EOL label; split recorder lists cell files across partitions. Prefix rows must not be treated as independent batteries.
findings.evidence: Explicit HUST/MATR per-cell lists plus loader prefix loop.

findings.claim: HUST Mendeley version 2 DOI 10.17632/nsc7hnsg4s.2 describes 77 LFP/graphite 1.1Ah cells at 30C and has CC BY 4.0 license.

BatteryLife README points MATR to data.matr.io, HUST to Mendeley, and says cite BatteryML for processed MATR/HUST. Exact license of each MATR/CLO release requires checking the individual file/project; the code license does not license data.
findings.evidence: README data availability/citation section; data.matr.io project content is JS-only in web extraction.

findings.claim: PBT official README specifies early prediction with first N<=100 cycles and cycle-life labels; not dynamic RUL.
BatteryML is a distinct Microsoft project with its own separately named RUL benchmark; avoid conflation with BatteryLife and PBT.

limitations: Only official repo ZIP archives were downloaded; no data was downloaded, unpacked, or checked.
The snapshots are main-branch ZIPs; no immutable Git commit SHA was collected.
Paper and current main may differ; pin the exact commit and hash split/label files before any reproduction.
Data terms are source-specific; MIT/Apache code licenses do not license dataset contents.
next_action: Pin immutable BatteryLife commit; obtain HUST/MATR processed data after confirming source terms; verify cell IDs, EOL labels, and split disjointness. If dynamic RUL is intended, preregister target EOL_cycle-observed_cycle and metrics; do not present official BLP scripts as dynamic RUL.

split_list_static_audit.method: AST literal parsing of official data_provider/data_split_recorder.py class attributes; no code import or model/data execution
split_list_static_audit.limit: Confirms only that listed filename IDs are pairwise disjoint; does not verify files exist, file contents, aliases/duplicate physical batteries, or actual downloaded data.
